artifact_review: The Router identified two key artifacts: texture anomaly on the cone and structural collapse in the screw heads. I agree with the severity ratings. The screw heads are indeed the most telling sign of AI generation here; they lack the precise mechanical geometry of real screws (slots are vague/melted). The 'plastic' sheen on the cone is also characteristic of AI smoothing. The Perceptual Quality Auditor missed these because it focuses on global noise/blur, not micro-structural geometry. The Topology Auditor's high confidence mask confirms the object is coherent, but doesn't rule out internal geometric flaws like the screws. The Depth Auditor's stats are neutral. Therefore, the Router's visual identification of the screw and texture issues is the primary evidence for artifacts.
